about: SGT overhaul work packages (blueprint docs/sgt-blueprint.md section 14). Fixed data: edit by hand only to re-plan. Live status is in docs/sgt-overhaul-status.csv, written only by tools/sgt_overhaul.py.

tiers._note: A WP's 'model' names one of these tiers. Models are tried in order; the first whose runner is enabled, installed and not at its usage limit is used. Opus-level work stays on Claude (owner rule from Sera Sync v3: no Gemini for expert work).

antigravity._note: agy 1.2.12 (Go flags; the prompt is the value of -p, so it goes last). Kept to the restricted mode (accept-edits + sandbox). Disabled until a test shows workers can run the tests in that mode; the unrestricted --dangerously-skip-permissions mode is the owner's decision, not the dispatcher's.

wps.what: Find why the SGT page corpus stopped recording after 22 Sep and fix it
wps.focus: ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_corpus/ on this PC holds only pages_2026-09-22.jsonl while ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_shadow/ logs run to 26 Sep. Trace core/sgt/sgt_corpus.py (PageRecorder), its construction in core/vsdc/vsdc_router.py (~line 427) and main.py read_sgt_record_pages / the sgt_record setting, and the SGT live commit 6ae61c5 (mode switch, set_mode). Find the real cause (not a guess), fix it in the smallest way, add a regression test. Read the corpus files only to diagnose; never copy any of their content into the repo. This touches SGT-C: keep behaviour otherwise identical.

wps.what: Baseline: SGT tests and replay baseline, recorded for later diffs
wps.focus: Run every tests/test_sgt_*.py and tests/test_vsdc*.py and record pass/fail counts (and names of pre-existing failures) in your hand-off note. Run tools/sgt_replay.py baseline on the existing corpus (read its --help first) and record where the baseline file lives and its summary numbers. Change no code.

wps.what: SGT-I host: the C/I contract in code
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.2 (all six rules). Create package core/sgt_i/ with: an Observation snapshot (read-only copy of what the Core read and captured for one page: lines, url, title, portal, source uia/ocr, the PageResult/resolved values, session id, timestamps); an SgtIntelligence host that runs registered SGT-I components on its OWN thread after the Core's tick, with a per-page time budget, exception isolation and a hang guard that switches SGT-I off for the rest of the run (look at core/hang_watchdog.py and vsdc_uia_text._run_with_timeout for existing patterns); an advisory channel that can only ask the Core for MORE reads; an enrichment channel whose output lands in raw_payload['sgt_i'] (never replacing Core fields). Add the setting 'sgt_i_mode' Off/On (default Off) next to the SGT settings in core/vsdc/vsdc_engines.py and Settings -> Tracker in ui/dialogs/unified_settings_dialog.py. Hook the host into core/sgt/sgt_shadow.py AFTER the Core has resolved a page, via a single guarded call. Tests: host isolation (exception, timeout, hang), Core output byte-identical with SGT-I On vs Off over tests/sgt_golden replays.

wps.what: Enrichment fields on tracker rows (no schema change)
wps.focus: Decision: new datapoints stay in the SGT lab only, so NO database schema change. Make SGT-I enrichment (route position, explanation, second opinion) travel in raw_payload['sgt_i'] of SGT rows, survive insert_tracker_dump, and show read-only in the tracker row detail if a detail view exists (ui/windows/tracker_dump_window.py). Tests: Core values unchanged, enrichment round-trips.

wps.what: Review: W0-1..W1-2 against the SGT-C safety rules
wps.focus: Review the diffs of W0-1, W1-1, W1-2 (git log on this branch). Check blueprint 14.2's six rules hold in the code, SGT-I Off is exactly today's behaviour, no Core value can be changed by SGT-I, threads cannot deadlock the router. Fix real defects you find (commit them) and list them in your hand-off note.

wps.what: Measure a cached UIA node read vs the current line reader
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 1 and section 7. Prototype a node read with a UIA CacheRequest (FindAllBuildCache: Name, ControlType, BoundingRectangle, value, selection, landmark/heading/table properties, parent structure) in a NEW module (do not change vsdc_uia_text.py yet). Measure against the current read_page_text on local test pages (tests/*.html, tools/ scripts that open Edge; VSDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_TEST=1) - normal and a heavy 300-row table. Record the timings in the hand-off note. If the desktop is locked or reads come back empty, record that and fall back to measuring what you can; add a row to checks with tools/sgt_overhaul.py check-add.

wps.what: Page map: node model, zones, sections, layout pairing
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 1. core/sgt_i/page_map.py: Node dataclass (text, role, box, table row/col, heading level, landmark, selected, value), builders from the W2-1 cached read and from OCR line boxes, zone classification (header, main, dialog, stepper, help, navigation/footer), section scoping by headings, label->value pairing by layout (right of, below, same row under column header). Pure functions; tests on synthetic node fixtures that reproduce the 14.1 bug table cases (option list vs selected, landlord PAN section, 'Search Box Input Field', truncated header name, unvisited stepper step).

wps.what: Lines view from nodes + equivalence check against today's reader
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.2 'the one shared part'. Produce the Core's lines list from nodes, exactly as vsdc_uia_text._collect_descendant_lines would (including 'Selected:' lines). Add tools/sgt_lines_equivalence.py that compares both on whatever pages can be read (recorded node pages once W2-4 exists; live windows when available) and reports differences. The Core keeps its current reader in this WP.

wps.what: Recorder stores nodes (corpus format v2, backwards compatible)
wps.focus: core/sgt/sgt_corpus.py and sgt_replay.py: record nodes as well as lines when SGT-I is on, format version field, replay reads v1 and v2. Keep the 30-day retention and 50 MB/day cap. Tests.

wps.what: Container -> value pairs with generic types and masking
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 2 and 14.5 privacy rules 1. core/sgt_i/pairs.py: from page-map pairs produce (container path, generic type, masked shape); generic types: text, number, amount, date, code, email, phone, choice, percentage, yes/no. Values are NEVER persisted; add a test that scans everything SGT-I writes to disk for any raw value from the fixtures.

wps.what: Maths 1: shape grammar induction with rule-of-three bounds
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 3 (shape grammar). core/sgt_i/shapes.py: class strings (A letter, 9 digit, keep punctuation), generalisation of many shapes into one pattern/regex, and the confidence bound (0 exceptions in N => exception rate < 3/N at 95%). Tests.

wps.what: Maths 2: checksum discovery, values inside values, relations
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 3. core/sgt_i/invariants.py: test Luhn, Verhoeff, mod-11, mod-36 (GSTIN scheme, see sgt_toolbox.c_gstin_checksum) over a container's values with a multiple-testing bound; substring-equals-other-container discovery (GSTIN contains PAN at 3-12; ITR ack ends in DDMMYY date); pairwise relations (<=, sum). Works on value summaries supplied by the caller. Tests with fictional generated values only.

wps.what: Maths 3: container kinds from salted-hash statistics
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 3 (container kind table) and 14.5 rule 3. core/sgt_i/stats.py: per-PC random salt stored locally (never synced), salted hashes to count distinct values and per-client stability; classify container as template / vocabulary / profile / dataset / identifier with support counts. Persist only counts and hashes under ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_i/. Tests.

wps.what: The atlas: model, page matching, merge, template promotion, ageing
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 4 (read the JSON example). core/sgt_i/atlas.py: one JSON per portal under ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_i/atlas/, atomic writes; page identity by structure overlap (Jaccard of role:label sets) with url hints; repeating blocks collapsed; mixed text as 'Welcome, <name>'; text promoted to template only when identical across >= 3 different clients (config), masked shape until then; optional regions with counts; first/last seen and retirement; transitions counted. Core must never need it. Tests incl. privacy (no client value in the file).

wps.what: Atlas tool: show / diff / coverage
wps.focus: tools/sgt_atlas.py: show a portal's pages, coverage (pages seen, slots claimed/unclaimed), diff two atlas versions (what appeared / disappeared - the portal-change alarm). Tests.

wps.what: The GPS: position, route, progress, row enrichment
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 5. Decision: rows only, no live position view. core/sgt_i/gps.py: routes = frequent paths from a starting kind to a confirmation kind over atlas transitions; position from a short lookback; progress 'step n of m'; odd-jump detection closes a route; context (form/period) as a second opinion only. Enrichment 'reached <page>, not submitted' via the W1-2 channel. Tests.

wps.what: Read harder near the finish line (advisory to the Core)
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 5 item 1 and contract rule 3. Through the W1-1 advisory channel, when the GPS predicts a confirmation next, the Core's change gate is loosened / reads made more frequent for a bounded time. It may only ADD reads. Find where the change gate and tick interval live (sgt_shadow.py _frame_hash, the router tick). Tests prove it never removes a read and is inert with SGT-I Off.

wps.what: Assertion checker (NegEx-style), trigger words in config
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 6 table. core/sgt_i/assertions.py + a config section (in core/sgt_i/sgt_i_config.json) of triggers and scope rules: happened / negated / future-conditional / reference-to-past. Tests from real wordings in core/sgt/sgt_fields.json examples and the 14.1 bug table.

wps.what: Page kinds classifier
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 6. core/sgt_i/page_kinds.py: login, dashboard, profile, list, wizard step, confirmation, error, payment from content signals (stepper, repeated blocks, dialog with identifier + happened wording, input-dominant) plus the atlas; abstains when unsure. Tests.

wps.what: Evidence ledger, retraction, explanations, second opinions
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 7. core/sgt_i/ledger.py: beliefs with sightings, config weights, truth-maintenance retraction, one-line explanations, second opinions (reference ack, ITR form vs PAN 4th letter, quarterly form vs period, identifier date inside period, form belongs to portal) written through the enrichment channel. Core values never change. Tests.

wps.what: Sera's own data: client list and tracker, read-only
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 8. Decision: allowed, local, read-only. core/sgt_i/sera_data.py: read-only cached accessor to clients (PAN, GSTIN, name) and tracker due/filed rows (find the tables in database.py; open read-only, never write). OCR constraint correction (confusion sets in the right slots + checksum, unique survivor only, only for reads that FAIL their shape), name<->PAN cross-check, masked-value confirmation. Second opinions only. Tests with a temp DB.

wps.what: Tracker expectations and self-healing (known-value anchoring)
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 8 (expectations, self-healing). Due filings as prime candidates; already-filed period flagged as revision/duplicate; known client values seen under an unclaimed container recorded as candidate synonyms for the miner. Tests.

wps.what: UIA events for short-lived messages + page diffing
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 9 (Downloads is OUT of scope - user decision). Subscribe to live-region-changed, notification and window-opened UIA events on the UIA worker thread (see vsdc_uia_text worker and its hung-worker replacement), feed appeared text to SGT-I as an Observation; page-map diffing (what appeared). Must stay passive. Test with a local page that shows a 1-second toast; if the desktop is locked, record a check with tools/sgt_overhaul.py check-add.

wps.what: 'Not understood' residue report
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 10. Count unclaimed containers/typed values per portal and page kind (counts and shapes only) and add them to the daily report in core/sgt/sgt_health.py. Tests.

wps.what: The miner: proposals from the atlas, maths and anchoring
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 11. Decision: every proposal needs the user's approval. core/sgt_i/miner.py: the five proposal sources, drafted specs filled from the maths (regex, checks, profile vs dataset), fictional example generator per type (valid-shape PAN, checksum-valid GSTIN, dated ack), gates (support >= N clients, type consistency, placement, replay diff; red flag if any existing capture changes). Proposals written to ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_i/proposals.json. Tests: generated specs pass the Core loader's self-tests.

wps.what: SGT lab screen
wps.focus: Blueprint 14.4 step 11 (lab). A dialog reachable from Settings -> Tracker: proposal cards (container, page kind, type, support, proven rules, drafted spec, replay diff), Accept writes to the local override sgt_fields.json via the existing override path (core/sgt/sgt_specs.override_path), Reject remembers. Decision: new datapoints stay in the lab (no tracker columns). Follow the UI framework and styles already used in ui/dialogs/. Tests for accept/reject logic.

wps.what: Final review and merge-readiness report
wps.focus: Review the whole sgt-overhaul branch against blueprint 14.2 and 14.5. Run all tests. Fix real defects. Write a merge-readiness report in your hand-off note: what is safe to merge to main, what the user must check by hand (list them with tools/sgt_overhaul.py check-add). Do NOT merge.
